reason: The cited evidence supports that Al2O3 and Cr2O3 are protective (E2, E3) and that increasing Al content improves oxidation resistance (E5). However, no cited passage provides evidence that Al and Cr diffuse more slowly than Mn in the relevant HEA matrix, nor that their higher oxygen affinity is the governing factor for selective oxidation in this system. E3 notes Cr diffuses faster than oxygen, but does not compare Al/Cr diffusion to Mn. The key mechanistic premises about differential diffusion kinetics are therefore unsupported.
premises: Al and Cr have lower diffusion rates than Mn in HEAs
Al and Cr have higher oxygen affinity than Mn
Lower diffusion rate and higher oxygen affinity lead to preferential oxidation of Al and Cr
Preferential oxidation of Al and Cr forms a dense, adherent protective Al2O3/Cr2O3 scale
Reducing Mn content minimizes non-protective porous oxides, shifting oxidation to a protective regime
